item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
• Live Activities. Downloads, AirDrop and Finder copies show their progress beside the notch, and new screenshots appear as a thumbnail, including ones copied to the clipboard. Settings → Live Activities.
  • Screenshots in the tray. Turn on "Put screenshots in the tray" and every new screenshot waits there, ready to drag. The first time, macOS asks to let DynamicBar see your Desktop, where screenshots are saved.
  • Swipe to change tracks. Two fingers sideways over the mini island play the next or previous track, with a haptic tap. The direction can be switched in Settings → Now Playing.
  • Swipe to hide the mini island. Two fingers up put the artwork beside the notch away, two fingers down bring it back.
  • Tray limits. Keep at most a number of items, remove them after an hour, a day or a week, and pin the ones that should stay.
  • Follow the pointer. The island can move to whichever display the pointer is on.
  • Hide in full screen. The island stays out of the way of full screen videos and apps until you point at it.

item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
• Choose the display. Settings → General → Display lets you put the island on an external monitor and switch between displays.
  • Displays without a notch. The island can be drawn all the time, with curved top corners, or stay hidden and appear with the usual animation when the pointer nears the top edge.
  • Added a support link in Settings.
